immutability_rule: A Decision Point may nominate Primary QAs but may not redefine a QA metric, formula, denominator, evaluation population, target, score bands, measurement boundary, missing/failure treatment, or official reference environment. Any such change requires a new QA contract version and re-evaluation of affected alternatives.

quality_attributes.name: User-Experienced Responsiveness
quality_attributes.formula: p95(end_timestamp - start_timestamp), with a 30-second penalty for a wrong or missing useful outcome

measurement_boundary.start: Voice: ground-truth acoustic EOS. Text: explicit input commit.
measurement_boundary.end: The later of required voice facts actually audibly delivered and required text-detail fields from the same result version available.

quality_attributes.failure_missing_treatment: Wrong or missing useful outcome at 30 seconds receives a 30-second latency penalty.

quality_attributes.name: Task Completion Effectiveness
quality_attributes.formula: 100 * successful unique goal instances / all eligible frozen goal instances; success requires every declared condition to pass

measurement_boundary.end: Scenario deadline after all required goal, binding, consent, result, and Voice/Text consistency checks.

quality_attributes.planned_population: 600 unique goal instances across at least 60 semantic families
quality_attributes.failure_missing_treatment: Any missing or failed required condition makes the goal instance unsuccessful in the denominator.

quality_attributes.name: Interaction & Task Continuity
quality_attributes.formula: 100 * episodes with every required lifecycle and event-interleaving relation correct / 400 frozen episodes

measurement_boundary.start: First event in the frozen lifecycle/interleaving episode.
measurement_boundary.end: Completion of all required relation checks for the episode.

quality_attributes.failure_missing_treatment: A missing or incorrect required relation makes the entire episode fail.

quality_attributes.name: Agent Ecosystem Evolution Containment
quality_attributes.formula: 100 * passing Agent evolution cases / 60 frozen Agent evolution cases

measurement_boundary.start: Frozen change request and predeclared ownership area.
measurement_boundary.end: Requested change complete and common regression contracts evaluated.

quality_attributes.failure_missing_treatment: Incomplete changes, common-regression failure, or change to unrelated Core semantic responsibility makes the case not contained.

quality_attributes.name: Evolution Change Containment
quality_attributes.formula: 100 * passing standard evolution changes / 60 frozen changes; LOC and file count are not the metric

measurement_boundary.start: Frozen change request with predeclared expected ownership zones and approved extension seams.
measurement_boundary.end: Requested function and common regressions complete, followed by semantic-dependency review.

quality_attributes.failure_missing_treatment: A case fails if function is incomplete, regressions fail, semantic changes leave pre-authorized zones, or a semantic dependency leaks into an unrelated zone.

quality_attributes.name: Cross-Device Adaptability
quality_attributes.formula: 100 * delivered requirement cells requiring no semantic modification of platform-independent VIA Core contracts / 60 frozen device requirement cells

measurement_boundary.start: Frozen Mobile, TV, or Robot requirement cell.
measurement_boundary.end: Required function delivered and Core-contract semantic-change review complete.

quality_attributes.failure_missing_treatment: Omission of a device requirement or semantic modification of platform-independent VIA Core contracts makes the cell fail.

quality_attributes.name: On-device Resource Amplification
quality_attributes.formula: candidate peak physically resident required AI-stack memory / frozen minimum mandatory AI-stack memory for the same workload

measurement_boundary.start: Start of the frozen reference workload's required AI-stack residency interval.
measurement_boundary.end: End of that workload; take peak physical residency during the interval.

quality_attributes.planned_population: Frozen required AI-stack workload set; case count to be supplied before qualification without fabricating instances
quality_attributes.failure_missing_treatment: Missing required resident-memory observations make the case ineligible for a score and fail evidence completeness; they are never imputed as low memory.

quality_attributes.name: Safe Task Recoverability
quality_attributes.formula: p95(end_timestamp - ground-truth fault onset), with a 60-second penalty when safe recovery is not reached by 60 seconds

measurement_boundary.end: All conditions hold: same logical UserTask retained; executor state reconciled; no duplicate or unsafe side effect; continuation-ready safe state; user-visible task state restored.

quality_attributes.failure_missing_treatment: Failure to reach safe recovery by 60 seconds receives a 60-second latency penalty. Unsafe or incorrect recovery independently fails architecture qualification.

hard_eligibility_gates.rule: Any unsafe or incorrect recovery fails architecture qualification.

quality_attributes.name: Least-Privilege Boundary Quality
quality_attributes.formula: Micro-averaged F1 = 2PR / (P + R), where precision and recall compare actually granted/exposed sensitive scope with exact ground-truth required scope

measurement_boundary.start: Scenario sensitive-scope requirement and principal are fixed.
measurement_boundary.end: All granted or exposed sensitive scopes and any state-changing action are observed.

quality_attributes.failure_missing_treatment: Missing grant/exposure evidence fails evidence completeness. Empty P+R is resolved only by a frozen scenario oracle, never by candidate-specific convention.

hard_eligibility_gates.rule: Any confirmed trigger makes the candidate fail security qualification.

quality_attributes.name: Trace Reconstructability for Diagnosis & Improvement
quality_attributes.formula: 100 * traces whose complete required causal chain an external evaluator reconstructs using candidate telemetry only / 200 frozen traces

measurement_boundary.start: User input or revision represented in candidate telemetry.
measurement_boundary.end: Voice/Text delivery plus relevant latency/resource attribution reconstructed.
measurement_boundary.oracle_isolation: Hidden oracle and fault labels must not be exposed in candidate telemetry.

quality_attributes.planned_population: 200 traces: 100 successful execution and 100 controlled fault/edge
quality_attributes.failure_missing_treatment: Any missing required causal-chain element makes the trace fail reconstruction.

quality_attributes.name: Long-running Task Feedback Freshness
quality_attributes.formula: p95(user receipt timestamp - VIA-boundary availability timestamp), with a 30-second penalty for missing feedback

measurement_boundary.start: The truthful/reportable event becomes available at the VIA boundary.
measurement_boundary.end: The user actually receives meaningful feedback through the scenario-required channel.

quality_attributes.planned_population: 200 events: 40 accepted/queued, 40 meaningful progress, 40 approval-needed, 40 completion, 40 blocked/failure
quality_attributes.failure_missing_treatment: Missing useful feedback receives a 30-second latency penalty.

quality_attributes.name: Barge-in Responsiveness
quality_attributes.formula: p95(t_last_audible_sample_of_previous_response - t_ground_truth_user_speech_onset), with a 2000 ms penalty when audible output does not stop within 2 seconds

measurement_boundary.end: Last audible sample of the previous response.

quality_attributes.failure_missing_treatment: Failure to stop within 2 seconds receives a 2000 ms penalty.
